run.hpLow.note: 150ms toast enter (translateY+opacity) then a literal-timed 400ms 3-beat scale pulse (1 -> 1.06 -> 1 x3), holds at neutral scale afterward until caller's own dismiss timer

run.autoRetreat.note: 350ms 3-nudge phase (translateY -3px x3, proportionally scaled from the cue's 460ms raw nudge pattern to fit the ≤700ms sequence budget) + 350ms screen transition (S-03-run -> S-04-run-summary) via runAutoRetreatScreenTransition — the transition IS the cue's documented final 350ms beat, not decoration

reducedMotion.note: nudges skipped entirely; screen hand-off uses runAutoRetreatScreenTransitionReduced (opacity cross-fade only)

run.death.note: hard-cut HP bar to scaleX(0) at t=0 (0ms, no drain) + 120ms silent gap + 600ms grayscale(0->1) filter tween on the same .hp-fill element — the one filter exception this game allows outside Legendary. No recovery-choice UI fades in afterward in Phase 2 (D-096); caller hands off straight to run summary.

reducedMotion.note: same end state (HP 0, filter grayscale(1)) with no intermediate tween
